mecca.name: Mecca
mecca.dict: Muhammad's own city, where tradition places the first twelve years or so of the revelation. The Quran names it twice: as Mecca (48:24) and as Bekka, site of "the first house established for mankind" (3:96). It is also "the Mother of Cities" (6:92, 42:7), and often simply "this town" or "this land" (90:1, 95:3).

medina.name: Medina
medina.dict: The town to which Muhammad and his followers moved in 622, by tradition, and where he ruled until his death. The Quran calls it Yathrib, its old name, once (33:13), and "the City" (al-Madina) four times, each time of the hypocrites and desert Arabs in and around it (9:101, 9:120, 33:60, 63:8).

midian.name: Midian
midian.dict: The people to whom Shuayb was sent, destroyed for cheating in weights and measures (7:85-93); and the land where Moses fled, watered the flocks of two women, and married (28:22-28).

mount-sinai.name: Mount Sinai (the Mount)
mount-sinai.dict: The mountain beside which Moses was called and where he met his Lord (19:52, 28:29, 28:46), and which was raised over the Children of Israel when the covenant was taken from them (2:63, 4:154). Surah 52 is named for it, and God swears by it (52:1, 95:2).
